title: GTA 6 Release Date, Launch Times, Pre-Load & Platforms
description: What Rockstar has officially announced about the November 19, 2026 launch, platforms, pre-loading and the information that is still unavailable.

sections.heading: The official release date
sections.body: Rockstar lists Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026. Treat that date as the current official target and check Rockstar Newswire or Support for any later change.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body: The official launch platforms listed for GTA VI are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not published an official PC release date.

sections.heading: Pre-load, launch times and storage
sections.body: Rockstar has published pre-load information, but regional launch timing, final storage requirements and platform-specific download details should be checked against the latest platform listing before launch. Do not rely on unofficial countdown posts for exact times.

sections.heading: Quick answers
bullets: Release date: November 19, 2026, according to Rockstar.
Platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
PC: no official release date published.
Regional times, storage and pricing: check Rockstar Support when the final details are posted.

sections.heading: Launch checklist
bullets: Check the official Rockstar VI page and your platform store for the latest release status.
Confirm your console has enough free storage before starting a pre-load.
Treat regional launch times, code restrictions and final download sizes as platform-specific details.
Use the official support article for changes to editions, pre-order eligibility or pre-load instructions.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is GTA 6 confirmed for PC? Not in the official platform information used here.
Can Standard Edition owners upgrade? Rockstar Support says the Ultimate Edition Upgrade can be purchased separately.
Is the physical version a disc? Rockstar’s support page says the physical package contains a download code.

title: GTA 6 Map Explained: All Confirmed Leonida Locations
description: A region-by-region guide to Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

sections.heading: Vice City
sections.body: Vice City is the urban centre of Leonida shown across Rockstar's official media. Its coast, nightlife, neighbourhoods and dense city streets form the main metropolitan setting. Exact district boundaries and many activities remain to be discovered.

sections.heading: Leonida Keys
sections.body: The Leonida Keys are a chain of tropical islands south of the mainland. Official screenshots show coastal roads, water and island environments; the complete list of settlements and activities is not confirmed.

sections.heading: Grassrivers
sections.body: Grassrivers is the wetland region of Leonida. Its waterways, marshes and rural landscapes contrast with the city. Rockstar has shown the region in official screenshots, but has not published a complete activity list.

sections.heading: Port Gellhorn
sections.body: Port Gellhorn is a coastal area shown in Rockstar's official media. Its port, roads and surrounding rural spaces suggest a different atmosphere from central Vice City; exact points of interest remain unknown.

sections.heading: Ambrosia
sections.body: Ambrosia is one of the named regions in Rockstar's official media gallery. The available material confirms the place name and setting, but not a complete map of businesses, missions or neighbourhoods.

sections.heading: Mount Kalaga National Park
sections.body: Mount Kalaga National Park is a named Leonida location shown in official media. The park's landscapes are confirmed; its full trail system, wildlife activities and story content have not been announced.

sections.heading: How to use the ViceCityCompass map
sections.body: Use the interactive map for a visual index, then open a marker to review its category, source note and confidence label. The basemap is an existing reference image, so community-estimated positions should never be mistaken for a Rockstar-published coordinate.

sections.heading: Confirmed versus estimated geography
bullets: Confirmed: a region or place name appears in Rockstar material.
Community identified: a location is matched from visible footage or a research dataset.
Unknown: no reliable source establishes the exact position.
Post-launch: businesses, collectibles and smaller landmarks will be checked again when the game is available.

title: GTA 6 Characters Guide: Jason, Lucia & Everyone Revealed
description: What official Rockstar character pages and media reveal about the protagonists and the wider Leonida cast.

sections.heading: Jason Duval
sections.body: Jason is one of GTA VI's two protagonists. Rockstar's official material presents him as part of the central criminal partnership with Lucia. Details about his complete biography and progression are not fully published.

sections.heading: Lucia Caminos
sections.body: Lucia is the second protagonist and shares the story's central viewpoint with Jason. Rockstar's official material places her at the centre of the duo's criminal story, while many personal details remain unknown.

sections.heading: The wider cast
sections.body: Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Bae-Luxe, Roxy, Raul Bautista and Brian Heder are named in Rockstar's official Leonida character material. Their exact roles, relationships and mission availability should not be expanded beyond what Rockstar confirms.

sections.heading: Accuracy note
sections.body: Names and associations can be confirmed from Rockstar's character pages, but a complete relationship chart, mission order and character outcomes have not been published. Community descriptions are kept separate from official facts here.

sections.heading: What the official pages establish
sections.body: Rockstar’s character material gives short biographies and relationships for the protagonists and supporting cast. It is useful for identifying who appears in official footage, but it is not a complete cast list or a mission-by-mission relationship chart.

sections.heading: Character FAQ
bullets: Who are the protagonists? Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
Are all supporting characters playable? Rockstar has not said that they are.
Are community nicknames official? No. Use the names published by Rockstar where available.

title: GTA 6 Vehicles Guide: Confirmed Cars, Brands & Models
description: A guide to the existing ViceCityCompass vehicle database, separating official names, community identifications and GTA V reference images.

sections.heading: How to read the database
sections.body: The ViceCityCompass vehicle database separates officially named vehicles from community-identified models. GTA VI images are marked as references, while older GTA V images are clearly labelled because the GTA VI appearance may differ.

sections.heading: Manufacturers and categories
sections.body: The current list includes sports cars, sports classics, muscle cars, sedans, SUVs, pickups, off-road vehicles and supercars from manufacturers such as Grotti, Vapid, Bravado, Albany, Declasse, Pfister and others.

sections.heading: What is still unknown
sections.body: Rockstar has not published a complete vehicle catalogue, final statistics, prices, performance figures or a complete customization system. Do not treat community model identification as official confirmation.

sections.heading: Officially named vehicles
sections.body: Rockstar’s current official material names vehicles such as the ’95 Grotti Cheetah, ’55 Vapid Stanier Sedan, ’67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, Ganado Retro Build and Shitzu Squalo in edition or promotional information. Other model matches in the database remain community identifications unless Rockstar names them.

sections.heading: Vehicle research checklist
bullets: Match the manufacturer and model before assigning an image.
Label GTA V reference images so they are not mistaken for GTA VI screenshots.
Avoid publishing performance, price or customization claims without a source.
Link to the original official page or a clearly labelled secondary reference.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is the 34-vehicle database a final list? No, Rockstar has not published a complete catalogue.
Are GTA V reference images proof of GTA VI vehicles? No, they are visual references only.
Where should launch details be checked? Rockstar Newswire, Rockstar Support and the official VI media pages.

title: GTA 6 Editions Explained: Standard, Ultimate & Pre-Order Bonuses
description: A cautious comparison of the editions and bonus material Rockstar has shown, without inventing prices or unconfirmed benefits.

sections.heading: Standard edition
sections.body: Rockstar's official store and support pages should be treated as the authority for the standard product, platforms, pricing and physical or digital availability. This guide does not repeat a price unless Rockstar publishes it directly.

sections.heading: Ultimate Edition content
sections.body: Rockstar's VI media page contains a dedicated Ultimate Edition Benefits gallery. The gallery is the safest reference for shown bonus artwork and named items; exact unlock rules and availability should be checked against the current store listing.

sections.heading: Pre-order information
sections.body: Pre-order bonuses and regional availability can change between storefronts. Use the official Rockstar Store or platform listing rather than third-party edition charts.

sections.heading: Comparison
table: Official artwork and benefits gallery published
Check the current official store listing

sections.heading: Edition comparison
table: Includes the game and an Ultimate Edition Upgrade with named benefits.
Contains a download code; Rockstar says no disc is included.
Includes the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+ under the listed conditions.

sections.heading: Buying safely
sections.body: Prices, taxes, region restrictions and storefront availability can change. Compare the official PlayStation, Xbox or Rockstar listing for your country instead of relying on a screenshot or third-party edition chart.

sections.heading: Edition FAQ
bullets: Can Standard owners upgrade? Yes, Rockstar Support says the upgrade can be purchased separately.
Is there a physical Ultimate Edition? The current support article says there is not.
Are all bonuses available in every region? Check the platform and account region rules before purchasing.

title: GTA 6 Trailers Explained: Hidden Details, Characters & Locations
description: A source-first breakdown of the official trailers and extended look, with interpretations clearly separated from confirmed footage.

sections.heading: Trailer 1 — December 4, 2023
sections.body: The first trailer introduced Vice City, Jason and Lucia, and the central criminal partnership. It is the foundation for confirmed visual and character references, not proof of a complete mission list.

sections.heading: Trailer 2 — May 6, 2025
sections.body: The second trailer expanded the cast, locations and story context. Vehicle and location identifications should be treated as reliable only when the subject is clearly visible or named by an official source.

sections.heading: Extended Look — August 27, 2026
sections.body: Rockstar's extended look focuses on the world, atmosphere and gameplay footage. It shows systems and scenes, but does not publish a full mission order or feature checklist.

sections.heading: Launch Trailer — October 15, 2026
sections.body: The launch trailer provides another official look at Jason, Lucia and Leonida. Trailer interpretation can identify visible scenes, while exact objectives and chronology remain unconfirmed.

sections.heading: How to separate fact from theory
bullets: Confirmed: directly shown or named by Rockstar.
Reported: repeated description from available footage, not official naming.
Theory: an interpretation that needs a clear label.
Unknown: no reliable official answer yet.

sections.heading: Evidence checklist
bullets: Record the trailer name and release date before describing a scene.
Separate what is visible from what a scene might imply.
Use official screenshots or Rockstar captions when identifying a person, vehicle or place.
Do not turn a visual transition into proof of mission chronology.

sections.heading: Trailer FAQ
bullets: Do trailers reveal every mission? No. They are promotional footage, not a complete mission index.
Can a visible vehicle be identified with certainty? Only when the model is clear or an official source names it.
Where are the official videos collected? Rockstar’s VI media page.

title: GTA 6 Online: Multiplayer Release Date, Features & Rumors
description: What is confirmed, what is reported and what remains unknown about multiplayer and the future of GTA Online.

sections.heading: Confirmed
sections.body: Rockstar has not published a complete GTA VI Online feature list or a separate multiplayer launch date in the official material used for this guide. GTA VI's single-player release information should not be presented as an Online announcement.

sections.heading: Reported or discussed
sections.body: Community discussion covers multiplayer systems, character continuity and how the next GTA Online could relate to the current game. Those topics remain reported or speculative until Rockstar makes a direct announcement.

sections.heading: Unknown
bullets: A separate GTA VI Online release date.
Crossplay support.
Character or progress transfers from GTA Online.
The relationship between the existing and future online services.
Final multiplayer features and business model.

sections.heading: How to check updates
sections.body: Use Rockstar Newswire and Rockstar Support as the primary sources. A headline, leak or social post is not confirmation by itself.

sections.heading: What a future announcement should clarify
bullets: Whether a separate GTA VI Online mode will launch and when.
Which platforms and account systems will be supported.
Whether crossplay, transfers or continuity with GTA Online exist.
How purchases, progression and privacy settings will work.

sections.heading: Rumour filter
sections.body: A leak, job listing, datamine or social-media post can be interesting research, but it is not an official feature announcement. ViceCityCompass keeps these claims out of the confirmed section until Rockstar publishes a direct source.

sections.heading: Online FAQ
bullets: Is GTA 6 Online confirmed with a launch date? No complete official announcement is listed in the sources used here.
Can GTA Online progress be assumed to transfer? No.
Where should updates be checked? Rockstar Newswire and Rockstar Support.

title: GTA 6 Missions Preview: Story, Heists & Known Activities
description: A careful preview of the Jason and Lucia story premise, reported robberies and the existing ViceCityCompass mission index.

sections.heading: The central story premise
sections.body: Rockstar describes Jason and Lucia as a criminal partnership whose easy score goes wrong, placing them on the darkest side of Vice City's sunny world. The complete mission list and official order have not been published.

sections.heading: Known scenes and activities
sections.body: The existing Missions page groups reported scenes, robberies and activities by confidence and timing. Names such as Rockridge Drug Bust and Hank's Waffles Robbery are descriptive labels, not confirmed official mission titles.

sections.heading: What this guide does not invent
bullets: No unconfirmed mission numbers or chronological order.
No invented rewards, unlock requirements or walkthrough objectives.
No claim that a trailer still proves a complete mission.

sections.heading: How to read the mission index
sections.body: The mission page uses descriptive labels for scenes and activities when Rockstar has not published an official mission title. A label can help navigation without pretending that an unconfirmed sequence, order or reward is final.

sections.heading: Mission FAQ
bullets: Are mission names such as Rockridge Drug Bust official? They are descriptive research labels unless Rockstar confirms them.
Are rewards and unlock requirements published? Not as a complete official list.
Can a trailer scene be placed in chronological order? Not reliably from footage alone.

title: GTA 6 Soundtrack: Radio Stations, Justice & Confirmed Music
description: A source-first overview of Rockstar's music announcements, Flash FM and what has not yet been confirmed about the final soundtrack.

sections.heading: Justice and the original score
sections.body: Rockstar has announced Justice's involvement with the Grand Theft Auto VI original score. Album timing and track details should be checked against Rockstar's latest music announcement.

sections.heading: Flash FM
sections.body: Flash FM is an officially presented GTA VI radio station. Rockstar's Flash FM page is the primary place to verify station identity, hosts, music and any later programming details.

sections.heading: Trailer music
sections.body: Music heard in a trailer is not automatically the complete in-game radio list. This guide keeps trailer appearances separate from confirmed station playlists.

sections.heading: Still unknown
bullets: The complete station list and final tracklists.
Every song that will be playable in-game.
Whether all announced music will be available at launch.
The full details of the official soundtrack album.

sections.heading: The stations Rockstar currently presents
sections.body: Rockstar’s official music page presents Cocoteo, Back Country, Afro Bank FM, The Chamber, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. The descriptions cover Latin music, country, amapiano, metal, pop and southern rap or hip-hop classics, while the final station and playlist catalogue remains subject to updates.

sections.heading: Music FAQ
bullets: Who is composing the original score? Justice.
How many score tracks are announced? Rockstar’s music page describes a 30-track original score album plus digital bonus tracks.
Is the separate GTA VI album the same as the score? No. Rockstar presents the score and the 34-track album as separate releases.
